_note: FICTIONAL SAMPLE DATA, WRITTEN BY HAND. Not a recorded model response. No model has run in this project.
_shows: Three questions, the maximum a single batch permits. One answered, one explicitly skipped by the manager, one still untouched. All three remain present in the payload; the skipped and unanswered ones are open unknowns and must be carried into any later advice.

questions.question: Roughly how many customs documents do clerks process in a week, and how long does one take?
questions.why_it_matters: Document extraction is only worth doing if the volume is high enough to repay the setup. Below a few hundred a week the manual process is usually cheaper.

questions.question: Is historical delivery and traffic data already collected, and for how long back?
questions.why_it_matters: Route optimisation needs history to be useful. Without it the first months produce suggestions no dispatcher will trust.

questions.question: Who inside the company would own this day to day once it is running?
questions.why_it_matters: The headcount constraint is named but not quantified, and every option here needs someone to own it after launch.

responses.answer: Around 400 a week across two depots. A clerk spends somewhere between six and ten minutes on each one, more when the scan is poor.
